title: LAMF Security Policy
description: Validates a LAMF security policy YAML/JSON document (DECISIONS.md §I, amended §U-10/U-11). Enforces the machine-checkable invariant-floor clauses F1–F12 via const/enum/conditional constraints. Every enum value is defined normatively in 02_SECURITY/SECURITY_PROFILE_OVERVIEW.md. Profile names are hyphenated everywhere (U-11); snake_case profile names are banned.

profile.description: Setup choice (U-11: hyphenated everywhere — YAML, schema, wire, CLI, docs; snake_case variants are banned). The four fixed profiles ship as profiles/*.yaml; ai-custom is produced by the 06_SETUP/ questionnaire flow.

version.description: Policy schema version. Pinned to 1 for package v2.0.0.

actor_auth.description: F2 (const): every actor authenticates; registration is pairing-only (lamf actor pair).

bind.description: TCP bind surface; tighten lattice (U-10g): socket_only > loopback > lan. 'socket_only' = NO TCP listener at all — the L0 transport (Unix domain socket / Windows named pipe with SO_PEERCRED / client-SID peer check) is the only surface (tightest; locked profile). 'loopback' = 127.0.0.1/::1 only (L1). 'lan' = LAN listener (L2, requires lan.enabled/tls/auth per F12).

enabled.description: Must be true if and only if the operator opts into LAN access (F12 conditional).

tls.description: F12: TLS 1.3 is mandatory whenever LAN is enabled.

auth.description: F12 (const): per-actor bearer token is mandatory whenever LAN is enabled; pinned required at all times so a LAN flip can never silently drop authentication.

pre_sanitization.description: F1 (const): sanitizer runs server-side, synchronously, BEFORE any byte reaches the spool; fail-closed.

value_detection.description: F11 (const): value-based detectors (known prefixes, entropy, operator-registered values) active in every profile, alongside source exclusions.

excluded_sources.description: F11/U-10(a): path/keyword source exclusions that must never be captured. The 16-pattern baseline (SECRET_PATTERNS.md §2) is MANDATORY and enforced below via allOf+contains per pattern — operators may only extend, never remove or empty, the baseline.

sensitive.description: Capture mode for sensitive-category content. 'automatic' is not available here; the least-gated automatic modes still store into a restricted scope with gated disclosure.

full_prompt.description: Capture of full model prompts. Never raw/unsanitized.

llm_transcript.description: Floor (const): raw LLM input/output transcripts stay OFF in every profile (DECISIONS.md §S, A2-16).

message_max_kib.description: DECISIONS.md §F: message body truncation bound (KiB); 32 is the hard ceiling.

tool_excerpt_max_kib.description: DECISIONS.md §F: tool-result excerpt truncation bound (KiB); 8 is the hard ceiling.

auto_durable_facts.description: Whether repeated user_direct facts may be promoted to durable memory without per-item approval.

external_content.description: F5 (const): tool_output and external_content NEVER auto-promote; explicit user_direct confirmation or operator approval required.

model_self_approval.description: F12 (const): a model may never approve its own durable memory changes.

automatic.description: Whether context capsules are injected automatically before model turns, and at what scope.

capsule_max_tokens.description: Hard token budget for any compiled context capsule (memory_context / memory_orientation).

cross_agent_read.description: When one agent actor may read memory outside its own scope. 'registered_local' still means registered, authenticated, paired local actors only.

cross_channel_merge.description: F6: identity merging across channels. Automatic merging is FORBIDDEN in every profile; there is no automatic enum value.

read.description: F10: disclosure receipts. Aggregation is permitted ONLY for ordinary reads; sensitive-category disclosures are always itemized. There is no 'off' value.

erasure.description: F7 (const): erasure = tombstone + per-record data-key destruction; redaction-aware raw-evidence fallback.

at_rest.description: At-rest encryption posture. Quarantine is encrypted at rest in every profile regardless of this setting (DECISIONS.md §J).

export.description: F3 (const): export bundles are always passphrase-encrypted (XChaCha20-Poly1305, Argon2id) with keyed MAC over manifest/checksums/chain head.

remote_sync.description: Whether any memory content may leave the machine for remote sync. 'explicit' = per-destination operator opt-in only.

mode.description: Optional Git adapter mode. Git is never required for normal operation; remote mode documents erasure limits (F7).

sensitive_classes.description: F12 (const): sensitive and restricted memory classes are excluded from Git in every mode and every profile.

ttl_days.description: F12: quarantine time-to-live in days; on expiry items are purged (quarantined -> expired -> purged).

ttl_hours.description: F8/U-10(c): pending approvals expire within [4, 168] hours; timeout = deny.

rate_limit_per_actor_per_hour.description: F8/U-10(b): approval-request rate limit per actor per hour, [1, 240]; anti approval-fatigue control.

diff_display.description: F8 (const): every policy change displays the effective diff before application (lamf security apply --require-confirmation).

downgrade_cooldown_hours.description: F8/U-10(c): minimum hours before a policy-weakening change takes effect (any key moving down its U-10g lattice is a downgrade).

step_up_auth.description: F8 (const): policy changes require operator step-up authentication (a fresh operator-credential assertion at most 5 minutes old, DECISIONS.md U-14).

max_seats_per_actor.description: U-10(e) (const): an actor holds at most one council seat — seats can never be stacked to reach quorum (T-council-seat-not-model).

quorum.description: U-10(e): ratification threshold for council_decision events (council.md §5); 'majority' = floor(seats/2)+1 member signatures.

allOf.description: F12 conditional: a LAN bind is refused unless lan.enabled=true, lan.tls=true, lan.auth=required.
